CHR_031.name: Firefly Swarm
CHR_031.prompt: THE FIREFLY SWARM, hundreds of tiny fireflies with bright golden-green glowing tails, proud and bouncy, drawn as glowing dots with soft halos at a distance and tiny cartoon bugs close up
CHR_031.anim_lock: Firefly swarm - bright golden-green glowing tails, soft halos
CHR_031.proportions: Same construction as Glim but brighter.
CHR_031.movement: Particle swarm with gentle noise drift.

CHR_030.name: Glim
CHR_030.prompt: GLIM, a tiny round firefly with a dark-brown body, two translucent wings, oversized shy round eyes and a rounded tail lantern that glows only a faint pale yellow-green; in its final form the tail glow becomes a soft white-gold starlight with four gentle rays
CHR_030.anim_lock: Glim - tiny round dark-brown firefly, oversized shy eyes, faint pale-green tail glow
CHR_030.proportions: Eyes take half the head; tail lantern equals head size.
CHR_030.movement: Hesitant fluttering, drifts backward when shy; steady and graceful once brave.
CHR_030.reference_requirements: Model sheet in dim and star states.

variants.STAR: tail glow becomes radiant white-gold starlight with four soft rays; body almost hidden in light

CHR_007.name: Thistledown Villagers
CHR_007.prompt: THISTLEDOWN VILLAGERS, a cheerful storybook crowd: a stout farmer in green overalls and straw hat, a tall old man with a white beard and wooden cane, a mother in a mustard shawl carrying a baby, red-haired twin boys in long striped scarves, a plump woman in a polka-dot headscarf, a skinny teen in a blue cap
CHR_007.anim_lock: Thistledown villagers - farmer in green overalls, old man with cane, mother in mustard shawl, red-haired twins in striped scarves, woman in polka-dot headscarf, teen in blue cap
CHR_007.proportions: 4.5 to 6 heads; simple shapes for cheap crowd animation.
CHR_007.movement: Cycle-friendly - walk, cheer, point, skate cycles reused.
CHR_007.reference_requirements: Lineup sheet of all 6; skate cycle; panic-run cycle; cheer cycle.

CHR_001.name: Milo
CHR_001.prompt: MILO, an 8-year-old boy, 4 heads tall with a big round head, small torso and stubby limbs; warm light-tan skin, messy chestnut-brown hair with one upright cowlick, big round dark-brown eyes with a white highlight, five freckles across the nose; mustard-yellow hoodie with a small white star patch on the left chest, navy shorts, white socks, red sneakers with white soles
CHR_001.anim_lock: Milo - 4 heads tall, chestnut hair with single cowlick, mustard hoodie with white star patch, navy shorts, red sneakers
CHR_001.proportions: 4 heads tall; head width = shoulder width; hands are 4-finger cartoon hands.
CHR_001.movement: Bouncy and quick with big anticipation and overshoot; tiptoes when sneaking; hair cowlick springs on every stop.
CHR_001.reference_requirements: Turnaround (front, 3/4, side, back) on white; expression sheet of 8; pajama variant (light-blue pajamas with yellow moons) for night scenes.

variants.PAJAMAS: light-blue pajamas with small yellow crescent moons replace the hoodie, shorts and sneakers; barefoot

CHR_002.name: June
CHR_002.prompt: JUNE, a 9-year-old girl, 4.2 heads tall, deep-brown skin, two round black hair puffs tied with orange bands, big dark eyes with bright highlights, gap-toothed grin; teal raincoat with yellow toggle buttons, purple leggings, bright-yellow rubber boots
CHR_002.anim_lock: June - two round hair puffs with orange bands, teal raincoat with yellow toggles, purple leggings, yellow boots
CHR_002.proportions: 4.2 heads tall; long legs for her size.
CHR_002.movement: Confident long strides, hands on hips, decisive pointing; leader of any group of kids.
CHR_002.reference_requirements: Turnaround; expression sheet; ice-skating pose; carrying-lantern pose.
